issue.title: test: TestPluginSOCKSProxy fails on Bun 1.4.3 (proxyconnect error instead of an HTTP 502), passes on the pinned 1.4.2
issue.body:
86cc7ac56 (hhh2210, #1630) records a full \`go test -tags nogui ./...\` on macOS arm64 with **Bun 1.4.3** where \`internal/plugin\`'s \`TestPluginSOCKSProxy\` fails: HTTPS through a dead SOCKS proxy gives

    proxyconnect tcp: 502 Bad Gateway: socks connect ... refused

as an error, while the test expects an HTTP 502 response. They reproduced it unchanged on a freshly fetched origin/main (68552188).

On origin/main 2c18c697c with the pinned \`BunVersion\` 1.4.2 (\`/Users/…/.bun/bin/bun\` 1.4.2), \`go test -tags nogui -run TestPluginSOCKSProxy -count=2 ./internal/plugin\` passes (1.65s, 1.21s).

So this looks like a Bun 1.4.3 change in how a failed proxy CONNECT surfaces to the plugin's fetch. It will turn red as soon as magpie's Bun is raised to 1.4.3, and a user with \`MAGPIE_BUN\` on 1.4.3 may already get an error where the host expects a 502.

To do: run the test with Bun 1.4.3, decide whether the host should map the proxyconnect error to the 502 it gives on 1.4.2, and make the test hold for both.

(LESSONS.md also lists TestPluginSOCKSProxy's 60s ubuntu timeouts with no cause found; this may or may not be the same thing.)

comments.body:
Reproduced on Linux with the real Bun 1.4.3 and fixed the test in my fork: [d16f32c](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/d16f32c358755633bca5c6835ffd4c7e8fc24533), branch `fix/socks-proxy-test`.

A failed HTTPS CONNECT is correctly surfaced as a transport error. The gateway already recognizes both `proxyconnect` and `socks connect` as proxy failures, falls back, and does not rest the account, so no host-side remapping is needed.

The test now accepts only the specific HTTPS `proxyconnect tcp: 502 Bad Gateway: socks connect ...` error as well as the existing HTTP 502 form. Other errors and bad responses still fail, and the working SOCKS route is still checked. Original test: FAIL; fixed plugin test plus plugin/built-in gateway proxy-fallback tests: PASS with `-race -count=3`, sandboxed Go 1.26.8.

Bun 1.4.2 and macOS/Windows runtime were not rerun. This resolves the Bun 1.4.3 assertion mismatch; it does not claim to explain the separately mentioned historical 60-second timeouts.

Combined validation: these changes are included in [065f0c8f](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/065f0c8ffc9e30225f3d468ef41ec414aab75e02) on `fix/issue-batch-20261023`. At that exact commit, `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m`, native/Linux/Windows vet and native/Linux/Windows builds all passed with Go 1.26.8, a temporary HOME and pinned Go caches (Linux host, umask 027). Cross-platform builds/vet are not Windows runtime tests. These full-suite results apply to the combined commit; the focused results above apply to the individual fix.


---

Round-25 verification follow-up (2026-10-26):

Follow-up on the October 25 report: I rechecked fork head d16f32c358755633bca5c6835ffd4c7e8fc24533 on fix/socks-proxy-test. `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8 go test -race -count=3 ./internal/plugin -run SOCKS -timeout=600s` returned 0. This covers TestPluginSOCKSProxy and TestInstallThroughSOCKSProxy, including the specific HTTPS CONNECT error shape in your comment. It is a focused rerun; I did not reproduce your Go 1.27.3 WSL2 full-suite environment, so I cannot claim that scenario is resolved. The existing fork patch accepts the specific proxyconnect/SOCKS failure while retaining the working-proxy checks. I am retaining that patch unchanged rather than treating a report from upstream main as proof of behavior with the fork patch applied. No new implementation or upstream PR was created.

Seen again under a full go test -tags nogui ./... run on a WSL2 dev box (go1.27.3, 2026-10-25, current main), passing calmly on its own:

    plugin_socks_test.go:128: https://vendor.invalid/v1/chat/completions through a SOCKS proxy that is down: 0 "", proxyconnect tcp: 502 Bad Gateway: socks connect tcp 127.0.0.1:52512->vendor.invalid:443: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:52512: connect: connection refused

The test still had timing in it: its dead SOCKS proxy was a port it had just freed, which the bridge or another test listener can take, and the earlier error branch required the bridge's body, which `proxyRefuses` may not have read yet. That is the shape erickguan saw in a full run:

    plugin_socks_test.go:128: https://vendor.invalid/v1/chat/completions through a SOCKS proxy that is down: 0 "", proxyconnect tcp: 502 Bad Gateway: socks connect tcp 127.0.0.1:52512->vendor.invalid:443: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:52512: connect: connection refused

The branch now uses a SOCKS proxy that answers CONNECT with `connection refused`, creates its bridge before the dead HTTP port is freed, and accepts either the bridge's 502 response or Bun's `proxyconnect tcp: 502 Bad Gateway` error without requiring the body.

[fix/2207-socks-proxy-test-deterministic](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/2207-socks-proxy-test-deterministic), commit a93c613a02a376e559f0884ad8cf1b865681927d

Before the change the test failed with the `proxyconnect` error above; with the new fixture and the old assertion it failed at `plugin_socks_test.go:140`.

issue.title: [Bug] 中断回复后会话无法继续：发往 Chat 上游的 assistant 消息没有 content 也没有 tool_calls，DeepSeek/Kimi 返回 400 "content or tool_calls must be set"

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 概要

在 agent 里**中断一轮还在进行的回复**（Esc / 停止，常见于模型还在思考、还没写出正文时），之后**继续这个会话**，magpie 往 Chat Completions 上游发的历史里会带一条：

```json
{"role":"assistant","content":""}
```

或者只带 `reasoning_content`（DeepSeek 下）。DeepSeek、Kimi 这类严格的 OpenAI 兼容接口直接拒绝：

```json
{"error":{"message":"Invalid assistant message: content or tool_calls must be set","type":"invalid_request_error","param":null,"code":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

这条消息留在 agent 自己的历史里，**之后每一次请求都会再发一遍**，所以从中断那一刻起整个会话都发不出去，只能新开会话。重试、failover 都没用，换同一个模型的另一个账号也一样。

- 涉及版本：magpie `v0.1.1275`（main `a751f528`）
- 参考实现：[`timonwong/magpie@check-hope-agent-779-compat`](https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/tree/check-hope-agent-779-compat)（修复 commit [`6d4f8517`](https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/commit/6d4f85175bbf2585b0b6235b9333354108165933)，另有一个只改测试注释的 [`48869097`](https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/commit/48869097)，基于 main `a751f528`）。**仅供参考**，怎么修、修在哪一层请按 magpie 自己的判断来。

## 1. 现象和前因后果

1. 用户在 agent 里发了一条消息，模型开始流式回复，先输出思考（thinking / reasoning）。
2. 回复还没结束，用户按了 Esc / 停止。此时模型**只产出了思考，或者什么都没产出**，还没有正文，也没有工具调用。
3. agent 把这一轮半截的 assistant 消息留在会话历史里：
   - Claude Code：assistant 消息只有 `thinking`（或 `redacted_thinking`）块、只有空的 `text` 块，或者是空数组。
   - Codex：一个孤立的 `reasoning` item，后面直接跟着用户的下一条消息（或者一条 `output_text` 为空的 assistant message）。
   - 直接说 Chat Completions 的 agent（OpenCode、Kimi Code 等）：`{"role":"assistant","content":"" 或 null,"reasoning_content":"…"}`。
4. 用户继续发消息（"继续"、补充说明），agent 把完整历史重新发给 magpie。
5. magpie 把这一轮翻译或转发到 Chat 上游时，得到的是一条既没有 `content` 也没有 `tool_calls` 的 assistant 消息。
6. DeepSeek / Kimi 返回 400 `Invalid assistant message: content or tool_calls must be set`。**`reasoning_content` 不算 content**，带了也一样被拒。
7. 之后每个请求都带着这条消息，会话从此报错。

**一般是"中断之后恢复/继续"时出现。** 不中断的正常对话不会产生这种轮次：思考后面总会跟着正文或工具调用，两者合在同一条 assistant 消息里发出去。

## 2. 同类问题在其它 agent / 网关里都出现过

报错文字一字不差，都是"中断一次，会话就坏掉"：

| 项目 | issue / PR | 场景 | 修法 |
|---|---|---|---|
| hope-agent | [shiwenwen/hope-agent#779](https://github.com/shiwenwen/hope-agent/issues/779)，修复 [#783](https://github.com/shiwenwen/hope-agent/pull/783) | DeepSeek，停止回复后留下空 assistant | 构造 OpenAI Chat 历史时跳过没有文本和工具调用的 assistant |
| ccx | [BenedictKing/ccx#35](https://github.com/BenedictKing/ccx/issues/35) | Codex → Responses 转 Chat，孤立 reasoning 变成 `content:null`；"模型已经开始输出回复、还没完成时按 ESC 或停止，之后无论输入什么都报这个错" | v2.6.94 修复 |
| crush / fantasy | [charmbracelet/crush#3794](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/issues/3794)、[#3933](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/issues/3933)，修复 [charmbracelet/fantasy#361](https://github.com/charmbracelet/fantasy/pull/361) | 思考中被取消，只有 reasoning 的 assistant 被原样发出 | **对所有 OpenAI 兼容上游**丢掉只有 reasoning 的 assistant；带正文或工具调用的轮次 reasoning 照常回传 |
| kimi-code | [MoonshotAI/kimi-code#2691](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/issues/2691)、[#2804](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/issues/2804)、[#2852](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/issues/2852) | 接第三方 DeepSeek 兼容端点，ESC 中断后会话永久卡住 | — |
| hermes-agent | [NousResearch/hermes-agent#82924](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/issues/82924) | 清理器自己产出了空 assistant | — |

fantasy#361 说得很清楚：DeepSeek/Kimi 的 reasoning 回传要求只针对**同时带正文或工具调用**的轮次；只有 reasoning 的轮次是被截断/取消的轮次，没有可以接着续的内容，丢掉是安全的。它最早（v0.42.0）为了 DeepSeek 回传把这种轮次保留下来，结果引出了这个回归，之后又改回丢弃。

## 3. magpie 里的原因（main `a751f528`）

所有翻译到 Chat 的入口（Anthropic / Responses / Gemini）都经过 `buildChat`：

```go
// internal/gateway/chat.go:350
if t != "" || len(calls) == 0 {
	am["content"] = t // 没正文、没工具调用时是 ""
}
```

唯一会丢掉空 assistant 的地方是 `pairToolMessages`，但只在**一组工具调用还没等到结果的时候**才丢（`chat.go:551-555`："outside an exchange it passes through, as on main"）。中断后继续的典型形状是 `user → 空 assistant → user`，在工具交换之外，所以会原样发出去。（工具交换里面的情况已经没问题：紧跟在工具调用后面的 thinking-only 轮次会先被 `joinSplitCalls` 并进那一轮。）

`TestChatThinkingOnlyAssistantKeptOutsideExchange` 明确要求在交换之外保留它，理由是丢掉后两条 user 消息会挨在一起，有些模型的 chat template 会拒绝。

Chat → Chat 原样转发（`passthrough`，`gateway.go` 的 `case provider.Chat`）不做任何删除：客户端自己发来的空 assistant 原样到达上游。DeepSeek 下 `withReasoningOnToolTurns` 还可能给它补一个 `reasoning_content:" "`，依然被拒。

各入口能否触发（读代码确认，修复前）：

| 入口 → 上游 | 触发输入 | 发出去的消息 |
|---|---|---|
| Anthropic（Claude Code）→ Chat | 只有 thinking / redacted_thinking / 空 text / `[]` 的 assistant 轮 | `content:""`，DeepSeek 下另带 `reasoning_content` |
| Responses（Codex）→ Chat | 孤立的 reasoning item；空 `output_text` | 同上 |
| Gemini → Chat | 只有 thought 或只有签名的 model 轮 | 同上 |
| Chat → Chat | 客户端发来的空 assistant | 原样转发 |

## 4. 现在能不能靠配置绕开

只能绕开一部分：

- 上游同时有 Anthropic 或 Responses 地址时（内置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、OpenCode Go、AiHubMix、302.AI 等），模型的 API 保持 Auto，或在 `modelAPIs` / 模型编辑页把 API 钉到 `anthropic` / `responses`，请求就不经过 `buildChat`。自定义 provider 可以在 "More endpoints" 补上 Anthropic 地址。前提是对方的这个端点接受只有 thinking 的一轮，这一点没有验证。
- 只有 Chat 地址的上游（Together、Fireworks、SiliconFlow、NVIDIA，以及只填了 Chat 地址的自定义 provider），以及 Chat 客户端的原样转发，没有任何配置能绕开。`extraBody` 改不了 `messages`；关掉 reasoning 也不会改写已有历史。

## 5. 参考实现（仅供参考）

commit [`6d4f8517`](https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/commit/6d4f85175bbf2585b0b6235b9333354108165933)（`48869097` 只改了一条测试注释）：

- **范围：所有 Chat 上游**，不只 DeepSeek/Kimi，和 fantasy#361 一致。理由：
  - 一条没有正文也没有工具调用的 assistant 消息，对上游没有任何可见内容，删掉不丢信息；
  - 严格校验的不只是 DeepSeek 官方，还有各种转发 DeepSeek/Kimi 的中转和自定义 provider，按 host/模型名列举不全。
- **翻译路径**：`pairToolMessages` 在任何位置都丢掉这种 assistant（新的 `bareAssistant`，`reasoning_content` 不算内容），删掉后如果前后两条 user 挨在一起，就合并成一条（`joinedContent`：字符串用空行连接，否则按顺序拼接 parts）。合并沿用了 `toolAsUser` 已有的做法，回应了原测试担心的"两条 user 挨在一起"。
- **Chat → Chat 转发**：新增 `withoutEmptyAssistants`，放在 `withReasoningOnToolTurns` 之前，规则相同。只删这种消息，其它消息保持原字节；没有这种消息时整个 body 按字节原样返回。
- **保留**：magpie 自己续写时发回的 prefill（`prefix` / `partial`，`continuation.go`），即使正文为空也不删。转发路径上带 `function_call`、`refusal`、`audio` 的 assistant 也不删。
- 测试 `internal/gateway/chat_empty_assistant_test.go`：用一个像 DeepSeek 一样严格的假上游，对空 assistant 返回上面那个 400，覆盖：
  - Claude Code 中断后的 6 种形状（只有 thinking、只有 redacted_thinking、空 text、thinking 加空 text、`[]`、`""`），同一历史里带工具调用那一轮的 reasoning 照常回传；
  - Codex 中断后孤立的 reasoning item；
  - 工具交换里的 thinking-only 轮次（守护测试，修复前也通过）；
  - 续写 prefill 保留；
  - Chat → Chat 转发（DeepSeek 和非 DeepSeek 模型各一次），以及没有空 assistant 时按字节不变。
- `TestChatThinkingOnlyAssistantKeptOutsideExchange` 改为 `…LeftOutOutsideExchange`，期望合并后的单条 user 消息。
- `docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md` 补了一条说明。

### 回退检查

把新测试放到 main `a751f528` 上跑（去掉依赖新函数的 `TestChatRelayWithoutEmptyAssistantUnchanged`），4 个测试失败，报的正是上游的 400：

```
--- FAIL: TestChatEmptyAssistantLeftOutFromAnthropic (0.90s)
    --- FAIL: …/thinking  …/redacted  …/empty-text  …/thinking-and-empty-text  …/no-blocks  …/empty-string
    chat_empty_assistant_test.go:99: 400 after 1 calls: {"error":{"message":"ds: Invalid assistant message: content or tool_calls must be set","type":"invalid_request_error"},"type":"error"}
--- FAIL: TestChatEmptyAssistantLeftOutFromResponses
    chat_empty_assistant_test.go:140: 400 after 1 calls: {"error":{"code":"invalid_request_error","message":"ds: Invalid assistant message: content or tool_calls must be set","param":null,"type":"invalid_request_error"}}
--- FAIL: TestChatRelayLeavesOutEmptyAssistant
    chat_empty_assistant_test.go:220: ds/deepseek-v4.1-flash: 400 after 1 calls: …content or tool_calls must be set…
--- FAIL: TestChatThinkingOnlyAssistantLeftOutOutsideExchange
    chat_tool_pairing_test.go:287: trace = "user assistant user", want "user"
```

两个守护测试（工具交换里的 thinking-only 轮次、续写 prefill 保留）在 main 上也通过，这是预期的。

另外：完整测试套件里 `internal/plugin` 的 `TestPluginSOCKSProxy` 失败，在 main 上用同样的命令也失败，和 #2207 是同一个报错（Go 1.27.2，darwin/arm64），与本修改无关。

## 6. 没有覆盖 / 没有验证的

- **没有用真实会话复现**：测试 fixture 是按上面几个 issue 里描述的形状构造的，不是从真实 Claude Code / Codex 会话里抓的原始字节。也没有对真实的 DeepSeek / Kimi 接口发过修复前后的请求。DeepSeek 不把 `reasoning_content` 当 content 这一点来自 fantasy#361 和 crush 的报告。
- 合并 user 消息会改变发往上游的消息结构（两条变一条）。对 prompt cache 来说，修复后每次请求得到的结构是一样的，只影响修复生效后的第一次请求。
- 插件 host 路径（Cursor、Qoder 等的插件 builder）和 Responses → Responses 原样转发没有检查。
- 中断后的空 assistant 发往 Anthropic Messages 上游的情况（DeepSeek `/anthropic` 等）没有验证。

issue.title: usage: show Codex service tiers and estimate Fast costs

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
This review PR is in the fork because `yetone/magpie` currently sets `pull_request_creation_policy=collaborators_only`; GitHub rejected upstream `CreatePullRequest` for this account. Its base is an unchanged snapshot of upstream main `138188a3`, so the diff contains only this change. [Upstream comparison](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/compare/main...hhh2210:codex/service-tier-cost-ui).

Refs [yetone/magpie#1784](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/1784). The [issue discussion](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/1784#issuecomment-6219296535) records the CodexBar reference and the intended scope.

## What this PR does

Codex Fast and Default currently share the same displayed usage and Standard-price estimate. This PR exposes the recorded service tiers and uses a model-specific API-equivalent tariff where the tier is known. With a flat fixture tariff of $2/M input, the same 1M tokens estimate $2 in Default and $4 in Fast; CSV, session/model totals and daily statistics agree on the $6 combined total.

- Requests gets Fast/Default/Ultrafast/Flex/unknown badges and a tier filter. Details keep requested, sent and upstream-returned values separate. Codex session shares are split by model, effort and tier.
- Pricing uses published per-model API ratios with the existing effective prices, including custom Standard tariffs, provider discounts, cached tokens and long context. Explicit reported costs win. Unsupported premium tariffs are unpriced; absent historical tier evidence stays **unknown**, with a labelled Standard-price estimate.
- An API's returned tier wins over its sent tier. The built-in ChatGPT/Codex route uses its sent tier for the estimate because that backend can echo `default` for Fast. The raw reply is still shown; this does not claim verified upstream routing or billing. A gateway retry that stripped the field cannot recover the original premium from `tier_asked`.
- Native Codex reads an explicit rollout tier or retained local trace metadata for the exact thread/turn. Incremental read-only SQLite snapshots retain identifiers/tiers, not prompts. Pruning, replacement and late evidence invalidate the relevant source, including copied history. No present-day `/fast` setting is applied to old sessions.

Reference implementation: CodexBar [`CostUsagePricing.codexPriorityCostUSD`](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/blob/0ff1cf55c0a27b63cbb4a7359e0ef2d098114d97/Sources/CodexBarCore/Vendored/CostUsage/CostUsagePricing.swift) and its [Codex priority trace reader](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/blob/0ff1cf55c0a27b63cbb4a7359e0ef2d098114d97/Sources/CodexBarCore/Vendored/CostUsage/CostUsageScanner%2BCodexPriority.swift), at `0ff1cf55`. This is a native Magpie implementation. Model support and ratios were checked against [OpenAI pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) on 2026-10-16, including newer long-context Fast rates. **Subscription allowance multipliers are not dollar prices.**

The [subsystem contract](https://github.com/hhh2210/magpie/blob/faa7347c9b43a5f939936d785c1e97988bd1b4c6/docs/subsystems/gateway-sessions.md#service-tiers-and-cost-estimates) describes precedence, historical gaps, API additions and cost propagation.

Scope: production +819/−58, tests +674/−18, documentation +84/−3.

## Maintainer review fix — `faa7347c`

Addresses [yetone's blocking pricing feedback](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/1784#issuecomment-6222364102).

**Problem.** `servicePrice` in `internal/usage/service_tier.go` sent every tier other than empty/`default` to `catalog.ServicePrice`, which only knows the hardcoded OpenAI tariffs. Other vendors' ordinary tier words therefore lost their price: Anthropic `tier_served:"standard"` and Groq `on_demand` became unpriced, and `openai/gpt-4.1` with `priority` became nil where main estimated it at Standard.

**Fix.**
- Only `priority` (including `fast`), `ultrafast` and `flex` enter the model-specific service tariff.
- `standard`, `on_demand`, `scale` and unknown tier words are priced at their effective Standard price, and the raw tier evidence is preserved.
- A premium tier on a model with no known premium price (for example `gpt-4.1` `priority`) stays unpriced.

**Where the change is.** The fix is in the downstream `catalog.ServicePrice` (`internal/catalog/service_price.go`), not in `servicePrice` in `service_tier.go`. `servicePrice` still passes other tier words down; they now resolve to Standard, so the effect is the one requested. The commit changes four files (+61/−10): that file, its test, `internal/usage/service_tier_test.go` and the subsystem doc.

**Behavior change to note.** The old catalog test case "unknown premium" (`turbo` unpriced) is now "unknown tier word" (`turbo` priced at Standard). This is the behavior the review asked for.

**New and updated tests.**

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Moved from magpie-community/plugins#94 by @stevezheng (the usage log is magpie's, not a plugin's). A usage record has no service tier field today (checked on main).

---

Hi! I use Magpie as a gateway for Codex CLI, Grok Build and Cursor models, and run daily cost reports from `magpie usage --csv`.

Magpie already parses and forwards `service_tier` (there's even a per-agent fast-mode toggle), but the usage log (`usage.jsonl` / CSV export) doesn't record it. So there's no way to tell which requests ran in fast/priority mode, which bills at roughly 2x.

Request:
1. Add `service_tier` to each usage record, both the tier requested by the client and the tier returned by upstream (the OpenAI Responses API echoes `service_tier`).
2. Include it in `magpie usage --csv`.
3. Optionally, apply a price multiplier per tier so `cost_usd` reflects fast pricing.

Current workaround: for Cursor I keep a `-fast` suffix in the requested model name, but client-side `service_tier` from Codex is invisible.

Thanks for Magpie!

issue.title: [改进] 临时关闭一个 provider 时，保留自动找到的路由组 auto-<model>，不让 agent 被改写到单个 provider（附实现分支）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 背景

magpie 自动找到的路由组（`auto-<model>`：同一个模型由多个 provider 提供）在其中一个 provider 被**临时关闭（switched off）**、剩下只有一个 provider 提供该模型时，会整组消失。

临时关一个 provider 是很常见的操作（厂商故障、换 key、额度用完）。可组一消失，所有指向它的东西都会受影响：

- 连到 `group/auto-<model>` 的 agent 会被 reseat 到单个 provider 的模型上（`internal/agent/reseat.go` 的 `sameModel`），agent 的配置文件被改写；
- 规则（rule）和用户自建组里引用的 `group/auto-<model>` 失效；
- 把 provider 重新打开后组会回来，但 agent 的配置不会改回去，全部得手动重新设置。

用户关 provider 的意图是"暂时别用它"，不是"拆掉它所在的组"。

## 示例

1. 添加两个 provider `a`、`b`，都提供模型 `m`，magpie 自动找到 `group/auto-m`，成员是 `a/m`、`b/m`。
2. 把 agent 连到 `group/auto-m`（或在 rule / 其他组里引用它）。
3. 关闭 provider `a`。

希望：`group/auto-m` 还在，只路由到 `b/m`；Routing 页面把 `a/m` 标为 switched off；重新打开 `a` 后恢复。

现在：`group/auto-m` 不再被找到，从 agent 的模型列表消失，agent 被 reseat 到 `b/m`，请求 `group/auto-m` 返回 404：

```text
404 {"error":{"code":null,"message":"magpie knows no model \"group/auto-m\"; did you mean b/m? Name a model as provider/model (as /v1/models lists it), a routing group's id or name, or a bare model id (one served by several providers goes to the group magpie found for it, else to the first of them in the Providers order); it has b/m","param":null,"type":"not_found_error"}}
```

（上面是在改动前的代码上运行下文 `TestFoundGroupWithAProviderOff` 的实际输出。）

## 当前实现

`autoGroups` 基于 `providerEntries()` 计算，而它只含 `On()` 的 provider（`entriesOff` 跳过 `!p.On()`）。所以"关闭"和"删除"对找组来说没有区别。

反观用户**改过**的 found group（`auto-…` id 已存进 providers.json），已经会保留关闭 provider 的成员：`membersIn` 路由时跳过，Routing 页面用 `memberJSON.providerOff` 标出。没改过的 found group 却没有这个待遇。

## 改进方案（已实现）

分支：https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/tree/feat/sticky-auto-groups
提交：
- https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/commit/6ee3fb3ebbc604938b5a6c896aa7059b17c4bf70 改进本身
- https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/commit/6d981bcc1ef98ce035cc3442dbf78730ce540021 更新 `TestProviderOff`（#163）的预期

改动很小，无新增存储状态：

- `provider.heldOffEntries()`（models.go）：用户关闭的 provider（`p.Ready() && p.Off`）的模型，与 `entriesOff` 同样的过滤（decision 模型、retired、用户禁用的模型都排除），和 `providerEntries` 一样在请求内 held。
- `provider.foundGroups(entries)`（group.go）：对 `entries` 加上这些模型跑 `autoGroups`，按 Providers 顺序合并（`foundFrom`），所以 provider 重新打开后回到原位。原来直接调 `autoGroups` 的三处（`groupsIn`、`DeleteGroup`、`RenameGroup`）都改用它。
- 路由不变：`membersIn` 只用可用的 entries 解析成员，所以关闭 provider 的成员被跳过，与用户改过的 found group 一致；Routing 页面已有 switched off 的显示。

保持原样的行为：

- **删除** provider 仍会把它移出组；只剩一个 provider 就没有组。
- **没有 key** 的 provider（如未登录的插件）仍不会组出组，装了插件不登录不会冒出新组。
- 组内所有 provider 都关闭时，组仍被找到但没有成员：不提供给 agent（`groupEntries` 跳过空组），请求得到现有的"空组"答复。
- 关闭 found groups（`SetAutoGroups(false)`）和 `AutoStandIn` 不变。

需要注意的副作用：一个模型若由一个开着的 provider 和一个关着的 provider 提供，现在会有一个只有 1 个可用成员的 found group，以前没有。路由结果相同：裸 id 仍走开着的那个。

## 测试

- `internal/provider/groupfound_off_test.go`
  - `TestFoundGroupStaysWithAProviderOff`：a、b、c 都提供 `x`。关掉两个后，`auto-x` 按顺序保留三个成员，只路由到剩下那个，仍提供给 agent，裸 `x` 仍指向它；全关时组还在但不路由；全部重新打开后按顺序路由到三个；删除 a、b 后组消失。只有一个 provider 提供的 `y` 从不成组。
  - `TestFoundGroupRemovedWithAProviderOff`：b 关闭时删除 `auto-x` 会把它隐藏而不是报 "no group"，b 打开后仍保持隐藏。
- `internal/gateway/groupfound_test.go` `TestFoundGroupWithAProviderOff`：`a` 关闭时，请求 `group/auto-m` 或裸 `m` 都由 `b` 应答、按组路由；`a` 打开后新会话由 `a` 应答。
- `internal/gateway/off_test.go` `TestProviderOff`（#163）：原先断言 b 关闭后 `group/auto-m` 从 catalog 消失，现在改为它留在 catalog 里、只由 a 服务，并新增断言：请求它永远不会到达 b。

回退验证（把新测试放到改动前的代码上跑，均失败）：

```text
--- FAIL: TestFoundGroupStaysWithAProviderOff (0.97s)
    groupfound_off_test.go:59: no group auto-x
--- FAIL: TestFoundGroupRemovedWithAProviderOff (0.03s)
    groupfound_off_test.go:124: no group "auto-x"
--- FAIL: TestFoundGroupWithAProviderOff (0.85s)
    groupfound_test.go:63: group/auto-m with a off: 404 {...magpie knows no model "group/auto-m"; did you mean b/m? ...}
```

文档：已更新 `docs/subsystems/providers-accounts.md` 的 Routing groups 一行。

基于 main `04e8aa8f`，在 `6d981bcc` 上跑全量 `go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./...`（macOS，go1.27.2）：65 个包 ok，只有 `internal/plugin` 的 `TestPluginSOCKSProxy` 失败。它在 `04e8aa8f` 上单独跑也以同样方式失败（connection refused），是已有的 #2207，与本改动无关。

GUI 的 Playwright 测试没跑：没有改 GUI 代码，`/api/groups` 的响应格式也没变。

issue.body:
## Problem

magpie writes Pi's `models.json` with `providers.magpie.api: "openai-completions"`. A model gets its own `api` only when it is Responses-*first* (`provider.Native`) or Messages-native.

That misses most of the models a user can actually reach on Responses:

- **`Native` uses `ResponsesFirst`'s allow-list.** That list covers api.openai.com, PipeLLM, Copilot, Azure, Bedrock GPT and ModelScope. A custom relay with both a Chat and a Responses URL, or a preset like Groq, is "Chat-native", even for GPT. `ResponsesFirst` came from a986ac38, where it chose which API the gateway *translates* to (Chat being the safest target). It was never a reason to distrust a provider's Responses URL. The gateway already relays a Responses request to any provider's Responses URL as is, which Codex does on custom relays every day.
- **A routing group goes on Responses only when every member is Responses-native** (`allResponses`, d82985ee, #1594). One Chat member puts a whole GPT group on Chat Completions. The gateway then translates every answer to Chat, and that holds a tool call's arguments until the call ends (#613), which is what #1594 was filed for.

## Proposal

Pi's provider defaults to Responses, and a model writes its own `api` only where it can't be asked there:

| Model | `api` in Pi's models.json |
| --- | --- |
| Provider `magpie` | `openai-responses` |
| Best on Messages (`Native` is Anthropic, e.g. a Claude) | `anthropic-messages`, `baseUrl` = gateway (as today) |
| Its provider serves it on Responses: a Responses URL, and the model's APIs allow it. Presets and custom providers count alike | none (inherits Responses) |
| Anything else, including Claude Code, Cursor, Devin and Kiro sign-ins | `openai-completions` |
| Group with any member that the rows above put on Responses | none (inherits Responses) |
| Any other group | `openai-completions` |

- **`ResponsesFirst` is left as it is.** It still decides which API the gateway translates to. A new `Provider.ServedOn(model, protocol)` shares `Native`'s list of served APIs, sign-in exclusion included.
- **`promptCache` is still declared only where the request reaches the vendor's own Responses as is** (`APIs` is responses). A relay model that merely serves Responses declares none, since its cache lifetime isn't known.
- **Prime Agent writes Pi's block whole, so it takes the same default.** pa-core reads `api` as a string and has an `openai_responses` provider.
- **omp, droid, dsh, StepCode and Pencil are unchanged.** `catalog.Model.APIs` is unchanged.

## Trade-off

The user, or a preset's author, set a Responses URL, so that URL is trusted. Models that Pi used to ask on Chat now go on Responses where their provider has one: Groq's preset, a relay's non-GPT models, a preset that lists all three APIs. If a vendor's Responses API is incomplete, Pi on that model will show it.

## Real turns

Pi asked each model once, through magpie, to run `echo pi-check-ok` with its bash tool. Each tool call ran, and the gateway's usage records show the endpoint:

| Model | Members | Gateway endpoint | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group/auto-gpt-6-sol` | ChatGPT sign-in + relay + Chat plugin | `/v1/responses` | 200, completed |
| `grok-4.6` on the custom relay | — | `/v1/responses` | 200, completed |
| `group/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | a preset with all three URLs | `/v1/responses` | 200, completed |

### Tool-call arguments: held on Chat, streamed on Responses

Pi was asked to write a 300-line file with its write tool, so the call's arguments are about 1.4 KB. The model was pinned to one member, a ChatGPT sign-in's `gpt-5.6-luna`, which is served on Responses only. Pi ran in `--mode json`, and we counted its `toolcall_delta` events, 3 runs per config:

| Pi's `api` for the model | Gateway | `toolcall_delta` per call | How the arguments arrive |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `openai-responses` (this proposal) | `/v1/responses`, relayed | 613, 613, 613 | 1–7 byte pieces over ~2.2 s |
| `openai-completions` (today) | `/v1/chat/completions → /v1/responses`, translated | 2, 2, 2 | an empty delta, then nothing for 2.6–6.3 s, then the whole 1440-byte JSON at once |

Same prompt, member and account. Only the API Pi asks on differs.

A Chat-native relay member asked on Chat (passthrough) streamed its arguments in both configs (613 / 614 deltas), so the hold is the translation's, as #613 describes.

## Not covered

- A per-group protocol choice in the GUI (#1594 item 3).
- Showing the effective protocol and conversion for each request (#1594 item 6).
- The same rule for omp, which is built the same way.
- Not tried with a real Prime Agent, a Groq preset, or a Claude on `anthropic-messages` (that path is unchanged).

Proposed implementation, on the fork's `feat/pi-default-responses`:
- https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/commit/86f1ba0ca69dd5ecb9d546def3f91c7118e091f2 (Pi's provider on `openai-responses`, a per-model `api` for the rest)
- https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/commit/a08166c516c86a1bcebf5b8f43cec3a922677a27 (a model goes on Responses wherever its provider serves it; Prime Agent too)

issue.title: [Bug] While the desktop app runs, every magpie CLI command starts its own plugin host and singleton plugins fail ("data directory already used by another service"), fix branch attached

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Magpie 0.1.1290, macOS arm64, with the Our Free Model plugin (`github:mu-zi-lee/magpie-our-free-model` 0.9.1) installed and signed in.

While the desktop app is running, `magpie providers` or `magpie plugins` in a terminal prints this on stderr. The exit code is still 0:

```text
plugin [error]: github:mu-zi-lee/magpie-our-free-model: provider.models: 数据目录已被另一个服务占用；关闭那个服务或使用另一个 managed.dataDir。
```

(The message means "the data directory is already used by another service".) `providers` prints it once and `plugins` prints it twice. The desktop app itself is unaffected: its runner keeps the lock, and `plugin-providers.json` is the same before and after.

## Reproduction

1. Open the desktop app. Enable and sign in to a plugin that runs one service per data directory, e.g. Our Free Model.
2. In a terminal, run `magpie providers`, `magpie models` or `magpie plugins`.
3. Meanwhile, watch `ps -axo pid,ppid,etime,command | grep -E 'host[-.].*\.js|managed-runner'`.
   - Every command adds a `magpie-bun run …/plugin-host/host-<hash>.js` whose parent is the CLI's pid. This was caught directly for `plugins`.
   - After the CLI exits, PID 1 adopts that host, and it lives another 2–3s.

Observed on a real machine (real HOME, read-only):

```text
24734     1  /Applications/magpie.app/Contents/MacOS/magpie
49339 24734  …/magpie-bun run …/plugin-host/host-448c7c8917b1.js
49341 49339  …/node …/magpie-our-free-model/src/managed-runner.mjs
# service.lock: {"pid":49341,"product":"our-free-model-standalone"}

# while `magpie plugins` runs
59524 59522  magpie
59539 59524  …/magpie-bun run …/plugin-host/host-448c7c8917b1.js
```

## Cause

- `run()` calls `provider.Hold()` before dispatching almost every command.
- Reading the providers goes through `heldPlugins()` → `plugin.Cached()`.
- In a fresh process `provGood` is false. So `Cached()` starts `refreshProvidersInBackground` → `callWithTimeout("providers")`, which starts a Bun host of its own and calls `provider.models` on every enabled plugin.
- `magpie plugins` list also calls `plugin.Plugins` and `plugin.Providers` directly. That is why it prints the error twice.
- Nothing checks whether a magpie on this machine already serves the gateway for the same folder. Hosts are per process, with no cross-process check.
- So any plugin with a singleton side effect fails in the second host: a lock file, a fixed port, a managed service. Our Free Model is one of them. The plugin also lacked a fallback for this case, sent separately as mu-zi-lee/magpie-our-free-model#10.

## Reference implementation

- [Branch](https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/tree/fix/ofm-plugin-host-lock)
- [Commit f73740be](https://github.com/timonwong/magpie/commit/f73740bea6503f0c4ef4e3245dd468876626201f)
- [Compare](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/compare/main...timonwong:magpie:fix/ofm-plugin-host-lock)

What it does. No API or gateway change; `internal/gateway` is untouched.

- **The lock.** A magpie that serves the gateway takes a lock on `plugin-host.lock` in the config folder at start (`plugin.HoldHost`), and holds it for its life.
  - Serving commands (`servesGateway`): no args, `tui`, `web`, `app`, `gui`, `tray`, `-Embedding`, `panel`, `serve` (what the daemon service runs), and a `magpie:` link in a build with a GUI.
  - It is a flock through `internal/filelock` (`LockFileEx` on Windows), which the system releases however the holder ends.
  - Go opens files close-on-exec, so the Bun host and agents the app starts don't inherit it.
  - It is taken right after `update.AwaitPredecessor()`, before `provider.Hold()` or anything else can start a plugin host.
  - A serving magpie that can't take it carries on exactly as today.
- **The probe.** Every other command probes the lock without creating it (`plugin.HostHeldElsewhere`).
  - When another process holds it, `plugin.LeaveToServer(true)`: `Cached()` skips the background refresh and reads the `plugin-providers.json` the serving magpie keeps. `magpie plugins` list reads the same cache instead of starting a host.
  - No lock file, a free lock (let go at once), or any error opening or locking it: behaviour is as today.
- **Why it scopes itself.** The lock lives in the config folder, so a sandbox HOME, a container or another user never sees another folder's magpie as its own. Tests run beside the desktop app are not affected either.
- **Unchanged:** operations that must go through a plugin still start a host: sign-in, add/update/remove, requests, quota reads and an explicit model refresh. They can still collide with a singleton plugin while the app runs. That is out of scope here.

Costs:

- **`magpie plugins` shows less** while the app runs: no load errors, no clash lines and no tools lines, since only a live host knows them. In `--json`, `loaded` is null.
- **One extra open of a local file** per non-serving command, plus a non-blocking lock attempt.
- **A serving magpie that started without the lock never retries it.** Examples: a second `serve` beside the app, or a GUI that later takes over the gateway. While only it serves, CLIs behave as today.
- **The fix needs the serving side too.** An older app doesn't take the lock, so a new CLI beside it behaves as today.

Production code +153/−3 (`internal/plugin/hostlock.go` +90), tests +321, docs +4. It is based on `d783df46` and merges cleanly with the current main `5774c790`.

## Verification (macOS arm64, Go 1.27.2)

**New tests.** All pass with the fix, with and without `-tags nogui`, and 5 of 5 at `-count=5`:
- `TestHostHeldElsewhere`, `TestCachedLeavesTheHostToTheServer` (internal/plugin). A helper process (the re-exec'd test binary) holds the lock; it is then `Process.Kill`ed, and the test waits until the lock is free.
- `TestCommandLeavesPluginsToTheServingMagpie`, `TestServingCommandHoldsTheHost`, `TestCommandAsksPluginsWithNoServer`, `TestPluginListBesideTheServingMagpie` (internal/cli)

**Each guard removed alone turns its test red:**

| Removed | Red |
|---|---|
| `&& !LeftToServer()` in `Cached()` | `the plugins were asked 1 times with another magpie serving this folder, want none` |
| the `TryLock` in `HoldHost` | `not held while another magpie serves this folder`; `magpie --version beside a magpie serving this folder still asks the plugins itself` |
| the own-lock check in `HostHeldElsewhere` | `this magpie's own lock taken for another's` |
| `leavePlugins(args)` in `run()` | `… still asks the plugins itself`; `magpie plugins started a host of its own` |
| `plugin.HoldHost()` in `leavePlugins` | `magpie [] serving doesn't hold the plugin host's lock` |
| the `servesGateway` branch (always probe) | `magpie [] leaves its plugins to another magpie` |
| the `LeftToServer` branch in `listPlugins` | `magpie plugins started a host of its own` |
| `return false` for a free lock in `HostHeldElsewhere` | `still held after the serving magpie was killed` (both `TestHostHeldElsewhere` and `TestCommandAsksPluginsWithNoServer`) |

**Full suite** (`go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./...`): the only failure is `TestPluginSOCKSProxy` in internal/plugin. It fails the same way run alone at base `d783df46`; that is #2207 (Bun 1.4.3). So the suite is not claimed green.

**End-to-end in a sandbox HOME.**
- Setup:
  - `serve` runs as the server, on a random port.
  - The repo's fake plugin `fakeco` is installed and signed in.
  - A `MAGPIE_BUN` wrapper records every host actually started.
- Hosts started per command:

  | Command | fixed CLI + fixed serve | old CLI + fixed serve | fixed CLI + old serve |
  |---|---:|---:|---:|
  | `providers` | 0 | 1 | 1 |
  | `models` | 0 | 1 | 1 |
  | `plugins` | 0 | 1 | 1 |
  | `--version` / `statusline` | 0 | 0 | 0 |

- Each command's output is identical across the three setups: providers, model lists and sign-in state.
- `lsof` on `plugin-host.lock` shows the serve process holding it, not its Bun host child.
- After `kill -9` of the serve, `lsof` shows no holder, and the next `magpie providers` starts a host as before.
- A second `serve` on another port, in the same folder, starts and serves normally beside the first.

**Not covered:**
- Our Free Model was not signed in inside the sandbox, because its sign-in needs a console and the network. So the real error text was not shown to disappear with the fix.
- The installed desktop app was not replaced.
- Windows: only built and vetted, not run. The lock tests poll for the release, since Windows may release a dead process's lock after a moment.
- On the real machine, 0.1.1290 also showed a short-lived host after `--version`. The sandbox didn't reproduce it, and its source is unknown.

I understand the repo doesn't take outside PRs, so the reproducible problem and a reference implementation are here. The branch is for reproducing, reviewing or reimplementing; there's no expectation that the patch be taken as is.

issue.title: gateway: 火山方舟月度额度用尽后每 15 分钟被重试一次 —— "reset at … +0800 CST" 不被 resetsWhen 读，套餐窗口也没进路由

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body: ## 现象 Ark Coding Plan 的本月额度用尽后，路由页上这个成员一直显示 `额度用尽 · N 分钟后恢复`，N 在 9–15 之间循环——也就是每 15 分钟被放出来问一次、再被 429、再休 15 分钟。 ### 截图 用量卡片（AccessKey 读的控制面读数，`本月 剩余 0%`）： 路由页上同一个成员： 同一时刻的用量卡片（`magpie quota volcengine --json`，AccessKey 读控制面）： ```json {"name":"5 hours","used":37.248,"resetsAt":"2026-10-22T18:57:56+08:00"} {"name":"Weekly", "used":59.651,"resetsAt":"2026-10-26T00:00:00+08:00"} {"name":"Month", "used":100, "resetsAt":"2026-10-25T23:59:59+08:00"} ``` `magpie quota wait volcengine` 也据此说 `volcengine is used up until Sun 23:59`。所以 magpie 手上有这条信息，只是网关路由拿不到。 ## Ark 的 429 自己写了重置时间 ```sh curl https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3/chat/completions \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ARK_KEY" -H 'content-type: application/json' \ -d '{"model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":1}' ``` ``` HTTP/1.1 429 (无 Retry-After) {"error":{"code":"AccountQuotaExceeded","type":"TooManyRequests", "message":"You have exceeded the monthly usage quota. It will reset at 2026-10-25 23:59:59 +0800 CST. …"}} ``` ## 怎么发生的 `restAfterMarked`（`internal/gateway/routing.go:813`）对 failQuota 的次序是 `resetsAt(body)` → `c.full(now)` → `retryAfter(header)` → `quotaRest`。前两级在这里都是 0： 1. `resetsAt`（`routing.go:630`）依次试 `resetsWords` / `resetsIn` / `resetsWritten`（`resetsWhen`，`routing.go:220`）/ `resetsZhipu` / `resetsAfter`。`resetsWhen` 要求 `UTC|GMT` 紧跟偏移与标点： ``` (?:\bresets? at|将在|将于)\s*…\s*(?:UTC|GMT)([+-])(\d{1,2})(?::?(\d{2}))?(?:\s*(?:重置|[,.;，。；])) ``` Ark 的 `… reset at 2026-10-25 23:59:59 +0800 CST.` 没有 `UTC`/`GMT`，偏移是 `+0800`，后面还跟着时区缩写 `CST`——三处都不满足，返回 0。这与 #1669 修掉的 WorkBuddy `UTC+8` 是同一族措辞，`+0800 CST` 是漏网的那一种。 2. `c.full(now)`（`routing.go:1079`）走 `candidate.allowance()`（`routing.go:1086`）：订阅账号读 `allowances`，key 读 `keyAllowance`。Ark 的 `readsKeyWindows`（`internal/provider/key_allowance.go:58`）为 false —— `planQuotaSourceOf` 里没有 `ark.*.volces.com`；Ark 的套餐窗口只由 `volcPlanQuotas`（`internal/provider/volcengine_usage.go:95`，AccessKey 读控制面）产出卡片，那条路不出 `noteKeyAllowance`（对照 `internal/provider/planquota.go:712`）。#1427 的 PR 文案已写明「用量卡片尚未接入路由，刻意留到本次改动之外」，所以这一级为 0 是已知缺口。 于是落到 `quotaRest = 15 * time.Minute`（`routing.go:156`，注释即 "out of quota, with no word of when it resets"），`By: "quota"`。路由页把它画成 `额度用尽 · N 分钟后恢复`（`internal/gui/assets/plugins/routing/client.js:1801`、`:3039`，倒计时由 `restWhen` `:531` 算）——那个数字看着像「额度 10 分钟后恢复」，其实是休息本身。 ## 期望 - 最低：厂商说了 10-25 23:59，就休到那时，而不是 15 分钟后再去撞一次 429； - 更好：Ark（以及同类「用 AccessKey 读套餐窗口」的 Token Plan）的窗口进路由，Smart 不再把它当「额度未知」，也就不会每 15 分钟白试一次。 ## 修复建议（两层，可各自独立） 1. `resetsWhen` 接受 `±HHMM` / `±HH:MM` 偏移，并允许偏移后跟可选时区缩写（`CST` 等）再是 `重置`/标点；`+0800` 按偏移读，不要退回 UTC。 2. Ark / Token Plan 接入路由：`volcPlanQuotas` 读完调 `noteKeyAllowance`，`readsKeyWindows` 对 `TakesVolcAccessKey` 为真。注意配额属于账号、不属于单个推理 key（#1427 已提），以及「一个 provider 只能有一个套餐」（#2849）。 ## 旁注 Ark 侧的计数像是有延迟：用量在 15:53 就掉到 0%，16:08/16:09 的请求仍返回 200，16:52 起才稳定 429。所以这个 15 分钟循环偶尔会「看起来能用」。 ## 版本 magpie 0.1.1318 (7dd965ed)，Linux x64。 关联：#1669、#1772、#1427。

repository.name: magpie

issue.body:
你好，想提一个火山方舟 429 配额重置时间的原生支持需求。

当前现象：
magpie 对 429 的重置时间主要识别 `UTC+8` / `GMT+8` 这类格式，但火山方舟 Ark 返回的是：

{
  "error": {
    "code": "AccountQuotaExceeded",
    "message": "You have exceeded the monthly usage quota. It will reset at 2026-10-31 23:59:59 +0800 CST."
  }
}

因为 `+0800 CST` 匹配不到，magpie 会走 quotaRest 兜底。现在默认只休 15 分钟，导致已经月配额耗尽的 key 会被周期性重试；如果手动调大 quotaRest，又会被 8 天上限截断，而且不同 key 的真实重置时间并不一样，固定值容易提前或延后恢复。

期望的原生行为：
1. 解析 `+0800 CST` 这种数字时区 + 时区缩写的重置时间。
2. 对 Ark 的 `AccountQuotaExceeded` 月度配额错误，按错误里给的真实重置时间休息。
3. 如果 8 天限制是通用保护，建议通过 provider 级配置或 preset 级 parser/quotaRestMax 支持，而不是全局放开所有厂商。

可以用这个真实 429 作为回归用例，期望 routing 里记录：

fail=quota
by=resets
until=<错误中的真实重置时间>

目前我的临时方案是在每台机器上部署一个本地反向代理，再把 ark-code / ark-plan 的 provider URL 指过去；如果能原生支持，就可以省掉每台机器的代理和 URL 覆盖。

谢谢。

issue.title: sessions: two agents told to share one folder under different spellings (a link, a letter's case on Windows) read its sessions twice: Pi and omp, Qoder and Qoder CN

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Found while landing #2932's fix (CodeBuddy Code in WorkBuddy's folder).

#2932's fix keeps each path once in `allFiles` and `callSources` (`distinctPaths`), and reads CodeBuddy Code's folder as WorkBuddy's when `os.SameFile` says the two are one folder. The other pairs of agents that a variable can point at one folder only get the path-text dedup:

- Pi and omp: `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` set to omp's `~/.omp/agent` lists each `sessions/*/*.jsonl` from `piFiles` and `ompFiles`.
- Qoder and Qoder CN: `QODER_CONFIG_DIR` and `QODERCN_CONFIG_DIR` on one folder lists each file from both `ccFiles` calls.

When both spell the folder the same, `distinctPaths` keeps the first listing, so a session is read once (under the first agent's name). When the spellings differ (a symlink or junction, or `C:\Users\x\.qoder` beside `c:\users\x\.qoder` on Windows), the paths differ as text, so each session is listed twice, under both agents, and its calls are counted twice in usage. It no longer crashes: that was the duplicate path in one refresh, fixed in #2932.

Not reproduced with a real install; this is from reading `allFiles`, `piFilesIn`, `ompFilesUnder` and `QoderDir`. A fix would decide the agent for a shared folder as #2932 did for WorkBuddy (`sameFolder` in `internal/sessions/workbuddy.go`), or key the dedup on the file's identity instead of its path text.

issue.title: gateway: 流式下 narration-only 完成被改写为 `finish_reason: "tool_calls"`（mimo 系列必现，导致客户端误判丢工具调用并反复重试）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Bug Description

流式（`stream=true`）转发时，模型纯文字完成（narration-only，无任何工具调用）后，客户端收到的终止帧是
`finish_reason: "tool_calls"`，但整条流中没有任何 `tool_calls` delta。

下游 agent 客户端（如 Hermes Agent）的 dropped-tool-call 恢复逻辑会因此误判"工具调用被丢弃"，同一轮
反复补发提示词要求"把工具调用发出来"，最多重试 3 次才放行——每条纯文字回复多出最多 3 次上游调用
（延迟 + token 成本）。

影响面（同一网关内对照）：

- 必现：`mimo-v2.6-pro` / `mimo-v2.6-flash`（经 OpenAI chat-completions 上游），流式，纯文字完成
- 不受影响：deepseek / glm 系列同网关流式正常；所有模型非流式正常；真实工具调用路径正常
- **不要求请求带 tools**：无 tools 的纯文字流式请求同样复现

## Steps to Reproduce

1. 经 magpie 网关发起流式 chat-completions 请求，model 选 `mimo-v2.6-pro`：

```json
{
  "model": "auto/mimo-v2.6-pro",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "只回复两个字：收到"}],
  "stream": true
}
```

2. 观察 SSE 流终止帧的 `finish_reason`
3. 对照：把 model 换成 deepseek/glm 系列，或同请求设 `"stream": false`，重复 1-2

## Expected Behavior

narration-only 流式完成应返回 `finish_reason: "stop"`（与非流式、与 deepseek/glm 流式行为一致）。

## Actual Behavior

- mimo 系列流式：`finish_reason: "tool_calls"`，且全流 `tool_calls` delta 数量为 0
- deepseek/glm 流式、全部非流式：`finish_reason: "stop"`，符合预期

## 根因线索（直连上游对照）

直连同一上游（OpenAI chat-completions 兼容接口，model=`mimo-v2.6-pro`，`stream=true`）取原始 SSE，
上游末帧 `finish_reason` 是 **`"stop"`，正确**。说明改写发生在 magpie 流式转换层。

两族模型上游末帧 delta 的字段差异是关键线索：

```jsonc
// mimo 末帧 delta —— 显式携带 tool_calls: null 键
{"delta": {"content": null, "role": null, "tool_calls": null, "reasoning_content": null}, "finish_reason": "stop"}

// deepseek 末帧 delta —— 不含 tool_calls 键
{"delta": {"content": "", "reasoning_content": ""}, "finish_reason": "stop"}
```

推测转换层以「delta 是否包含 `tool_calls` 键」判定工具调用活动，`tool_calls: null` 被误判，
进而把终止帧 `finish_reason` 改写为 `tool_calls`。

## 建议修复

判定改为 `delta.tool_calls` **非 null 且数组长度 > 0**；只有整流真实出现过 tool_call delta 时才允许
`finish_reason: "tool_calls"`。建议补回归用例：`stream + tools + narration-only → finish_reason=stop`。

## Environment

- magpie: 0.1.1318（macOS）
- 网关形态：本地 magpie，OpenAI chat-completions 上游（`baseAPI: chat`）
- 受影响模型：mimo-v2.6-pro、mimo-v2.6-flash
- 对照模型：deepseek-v4.1-flash、glm-5.3（正常）

## Additional Context

- 最小复现与三组对照脚本（Python stdlib，可直接跑）可按需提供
- 与 #2471（`finish_reason:"error"` 误判为成功）同属 finish_reason 透传/改写问题域，但触发条件与表现不同

issue.title: rest-cap (and quotaRest) set on a subscription provider is silently ignored: withPicks doesn't carry RestCap/QuotaRest

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

`magpie provider rest-cap <id> 6h` writes `restCap: 360` into `providers.json`, but for subscription (signed-in account) providers the value never reaches the runtime provider — routing keeps using the default cap (10 minutes, 30 when rate limited). Key-based providers work fine.

## Repro

1. On a subscription provider (e.g. `antigravity`, `workbuddy-ai`, `commandcode-plan` — any provider that comes from `Accounts()` rather than a user-typed key):

   ```
   magpie provider rest-cap antigravity 6h
   magpie provider rest-cap antigravity
   # Antigravity · a key or account that keeps failing sits out at most 10 minutes, 30 when rate limited (magpie's own)
   ```

2. `providers.json` does contain `"restCap": 360` on the `antigravity` record, so the write succeeded — but the read-back still shows the default.

3. Same command on a key-based provider (`cloudwise`, `xiaomi`, `opencode-go`) updates and reads back correctly (`sits out at most 6 hours`).

## Root cause

`internal/provider/provider.go` — `allProviders()` builds account-backed providers from `Accounts()` and merges the user's `providers.json` record via `withPicks(a, pk)`. The field list in `withPicks` copies `Models`, `Routing`, `Affinity`, `AccountCaps`, `MaxConcurrency`, `MaxRPM`, … but **not `RestCap`** (and `QuotaRest` is missing too). So for any provider whose provider object is an account clone, the user's rest cap (and quota rest) is dropped and the gateway's `RestCapOr(longestRateRest)` falls back to the default.

Suggested fix: add `a.RestCap, a.QuotaRest = pk.RestCap, pk.QuotaRest` to `withPicks` (they are safe, per-provider knobs like the rest of the copied set).

## Impact

The per-provider rest cap is one of the main levers against fallback chains re-probing a repeatedly failing member every request (TTFT cost). On subscription providers — often the primary member of a routing group — the knob silently does nothing, so repeated 429/unknown failures only back off to 10/30 minutes.

Verified on magpie 0.1.1278 (macOS arm64).

issue.title: 404 for an unknown "auto/…" model reports a synthesized id ("group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash") instead of the id the client sent

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### What happens

An unknown model id that starts with `auto/` makes the gateway report a **synthesized internal id** that the client never sent:

```
POST /v1/chat/completions   {"model": "auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash", ...}
→ 404  magpie knows no model "group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash"; did you mean
       workbuddy-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash, opencode-zen-free/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free,
       openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free?
```

The client sent `auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash`; the message talks about `group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash` — a different string, with the dots rewritten to dashes and a `group/` prefix. That id exists nowhere: it is not in `GET /v1/models`, not in `magpie groups`, and cannot be searched or copied back.

### Why it is inconsistent

| request `model` | 404 message names |
|---|---|
| `auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash` ← synthesized |
| `auto/nope-model` | `group/auto-nope-model` ← synthesized |
| `nosuchgroup/foo` | `nosuchgroup/foo` ← echoed verbatim |
| `magpie/workbuddy-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `magpie/workbuddy-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash` ← echoed verbatim |

So only the `auto/…` path leaks an internal key; every other unknown id is echoed as sent.

### Environment

- magpie `0.1.1296` (Windows 11, gateway on `127.0.0.1:3425`)
- `magpie groups` on this machine lists exactly one auto group: `auto/step-5-preview` (smart, `workbuddy/step-5-preview · workbuddy-ai/step-5-preview`)

### Repro

```bash
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":8}'
```

### Expected

One of:

- echo the requested id verbatim (`magpie knows no model "auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash"`), same as the `nosuchgroup/foo` path, or
- name the real problem: `"auto" is not a routing group; auto groups are named auto/<model> (e.g. auto/step-5-preview)`, or
- list the members of the auto group it matched instead of global-catalog suggestions.

### Why it matters

A client integration that logs the error string will search for `group/auto-deepseek-v4-1-flash`, find nothing, and conclude the router is broken rather than the model name is wrong. I lost time on exactly this: the real cause was a model id from a different namespace, but the message pointed at an id that does not exist. Echoing the requested string (or saying which group was matched and what it contains) would have made it a one-line fix.

Minor, unrelated: `{"model":"workbuddy-ai/nope"}` returns `400 WorkBuddy AI: model [nope] service info not found` while other unknown models return 404 — upstream pass-through, mentioning only in case 400 vs 404 matters to clients' retry logic.

issue.title: gateway/antigravity: union type ["string","array"] keeps items but collapses to string — Gemini 400 on tool schema

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

A Codex Desktop conversation routed through magpie to an Antigravity account fails before generation when an MCP tool declares a parameter as a JSON Schema type **union** that combines `string` and `array` while also defining `items`.

Observed error:

```text
Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[23].parameters.properties[disease].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[23].parameters.properties[drug].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
```

HTTP 400, deterministic on every turn that includes the tool. The same tool set works fine through OpenAI-compatible providers on the same gateway.

## Environment

- Client: Codex Desktop, agent `codex@wsl:Ubuntu-22.04`
- Route: Codex → magpie gateway → Antigravity subscription (`gemini-3.8-flash`)
- magpie: `0.1.1306` (Windows)
- Observed: 2026-10-21
- MCP server: `biomcp` 0.9.3 (`biomcp serve`), tool `search`

## Minimal schema shape

The `search` tool declares `disease` and `drug` as:

```json
{
  "disease": {
    "type": ["string", "array"],
    "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 256 },
    "minItems": 1,
    "maxItems": 3,
    "minLength": 1,
    "maxLength": 256,
    "uniqueItems": true
  }
}
```

This is valid JSON Schema: the parameter accepts either a single string or an array of strings.

## Root cause

`plainSchema()` in `internal/gateway/codeassist.go` folds the `type` list like this:

```go
case "type":
    if ts, ok := v.([]any); ok {
        for _, t := range ts {
            if t == "null" {
                out["nullable"] = true
            } else if out["type"] == nil {
                out["type"] = t
            }
        }
    }
```

The first non-`null` member wins, so `["string", "array"]` collapses to `type: "string"`. Meanwhile `case "items"` copies `items` through verbatim. The emitted schema is:

```json
{ "type": "string", "items": { ... }, "minItems": 1, "maxItems": 3, "uniqueItems": true }
```

`uniqueItems` is dropped (outside the subset), but `items`, `minItems`, and `maxItems` all survive on a non-array type — and Antigravity's `Schema.items` predicate requires `$type == Type.ARRAY`, hence the 400.

This is the mirror image of #2784 / #2826 (array schemas missing `items`); here it is `items` surviving on a non-array type.

## Proposed fix

When `type` is a list, pick the member consistent with the schema's sibling keywords rather than blindly taking the first non-null entry. Minimal rule covering this case: if `x["items"] != nil` (or `minItems` / `maxItems` / `uniqueItems` present) and the list contains `"array"`, select `"array"`. Symmetrically, if the chosen type ends up non-array, drop `items`/`minItems`/`maxItems`/`uniqueItems` so the emitted schema stays self-consistent — Gemini validates `items` only against `type`, so either choice unblocks the request.

issue.title: gateway: Qoder's per-model queue 503 rests the whole account, so sibling models are refused without asking upstream

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
# gateway: Qoder's per-model queue 503 rests the whole account, so sibling models are refused without asking upstream

## Summary

A provider that answers a **per-model** rate/queue refusal with a 5xx (Qoder's `503 ... queued the request for <model>`), instead of a 429, is classified as `failOther` and rests the **whole account** (`restKey()`). Sibling models that the same account can still serve are rested with it, and with more than one account the group ends up failover-ing between accounts on the one model that is out, each resting its account.

This is the same shape of problem as #3039 (a relay's model-scoped 429 resting the whole key) and WorkBuddy's "switch to other models" (handled in `restAfterMarked`), but it arrives on a **different branch**: `failOther` rather than `failQuota`/`failRate`.

## The refusal

Qoder answers a congested free model with:

```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable

Qoder: Qoder queued the request for <model> (this plan's queue: p3); try again in 30s
```

The body names exactly one model, and the queue is that plan's queue for that model. The account's other models are not in it and still answer.

## Where it lands

`internal/gateway/routing.go`, `failure(status, body)`:

- `proxyDown` (L351) — no
- `Verification` on 401/403 (L354) — no
- `restrictedSaid` (L360) — no
- `overflowed` (L362) — no
- `status == 402` (L366, L373) — no
- `status == 429` (L375, L381, L385) — no
- `status >= 500 && quotaCodes.Match(body)` (L383) — **no**: `quotaCodes` is `limit reached\|\d{10}\b|usage_limit_reached|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`, and the body says "queued the request"

→ falls through to `return failOther` (L388).

`restAfterMarked`, the `default:` branch (L898–944):

```go
counted := c.restKey()
if unserved {                     // only a model the plan does not serve
    counted = c.restID()
}
```

`unserved` requires `modelRefused(status, body) || codeAssistModelMissing(...)`, neither of which matches a queue refusal. So `counted = c.restKey()`: the **account** rests, on the whole-account backoff ladder (`min(fallbackCooldown<<min(n-1,10), RestCap)`, 1 → 2 → 4 … minutes).

## Why the model-scoping that exists does not catch it

`restAfterMarked` already narrows the rest to the model in four cases (L962–989):

| condition | why it does not apply here |
|---|---|
| `why == failRate && isOpenRouterFree() && sharedPool` | not OpenRouter |
| `pooled \|\| unserved \|\| modelBackoff \|\| why == failQuota && resetsWhen && otherModels` | **requires `failQuota`**; this is `failOther` |
| `why == failQuota && clineModelLimited` | requires `failQuota` |
| `(why == failCredit \|\| why == failQuota) && PaidBesideFree` | requires quota/credit |

Every narrowing branch keys on `failQuota`, `failCredit` or `failRate`; none covers `failOther`, and none matches a body that merely names the model being queued.

`rateRest`'s comment (L1025–1033) shows the same gap from the other side: it notes WorkBuddy's free model being refused repeatedly while the account still had credits, and fixes the **length** of the rest (doubling backoff), but not its **scope** — the account still rests whole.

## Effect

- One model out → every model of that account rests until the ladder ends.
- Two accounts, one model out → each rests its account, and the group alternates accounts on a model that is out for both, paying a whole-account rest each time.
- `magpie accounts` / the Providers page report the account as out although its other models answer upstream.

## Suggestion

Narrow the rest to the model when the refusal names it, on whichever branch it arrives:

- in `failure()`, a 5xx (and a 429) whose body names the model being asked — the way `otherModels` / `modelRefused` already key on wording — could be its own reason, or
- in `restAfterMarked`'s `default:` branch, treat a body naming `c.model` (as `Qoder queued the request for <model>` does) as `unserved`-like for the purpose of the rest key, so `counted = c.restID()`.

Either way the account's siblings keep going upstream, and only the model whose queue refused is benched — matching what the existing WorkBuddy / Cline / OpenRouter branches already do.

## Notes

- Same branch (`failOther`) is reached for any vendor that answers a per-model queue/congestion with a 5xx instead of a 429, so the fix is not Qoder-specific.
- Reported from the Windows desktop build, gateway `v0.1.1307`; the code paths above are read at `origin/main` (`7dd965ed`).

issue.title: [bug] decide= on a plugin provider (commandcode-plan) reports saved but never persists — Command Code Jev unreachable without a custom-provider detour

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Problem

`magpie provider set commandcode-plan decide=…` prints `✓ saved`, but the field is dropped immediately: the provider entry in providers.json has no `decide`, `magpie provider commandcode-plan` doesn't show it, and `POST /v1/systemone` with `commandcode-plan/typesafe/jev` answers:

```
magpie knows no Jev model "commandcode-plan/typesafe/jev"; name the provider before it, like openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.14
```

Meanwhile a group member on the plan provider gets plain chat completions, which Command Code's chat endpoint refuses:

```
Command Code Plan: Model "typesafe/jev" is not supported on this endpoint.
```

So a decision group can never reach Command Code's Jev through the plan provider.

## Command Code does serve Jev (verified against the live API)

- `POST https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1/systemone`, TypeSafe SystemOne body (`state` + `questions` + `model`), key in `Authorization: Bearer` and `x-api-key`.
- The endpoint's own validation names its models — sending `model: "garbage/vendor-xyz"` returns:

```
Model "garbage/vendor-xyz" is not supported on this endpoint. Use one of: typesafe/jev, typesafe/jev-1.14.0.
```

- The provider's `/provider/v1/models` list (92 models) does not include them, so catalog fetches never reveal Jev.
- On a GOAT account the call currently ends `insufficient credits` (Jev draws from credits, not the plan's usage windows), but route and model validation pass — the wiring is the only gap.

## Workaround (works end-to-end on 0.1.1309)

```
magpie provider add cc-jev decide=https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1 key=<commandcode key> models=typesafe/jev
magpie group add Jev id=jev models=cc-jev/typesafe/jev routing=order
# POST /v1/systemone model=group/jev → reaches the endpoint, fails only on the account's credits
```

Note `decide=` must be the base (`…/provider/v1`); magpie appends `/systemone`.

## Expected

Either keep the k=v fields (`decide`, `url`, …) set on plugin-managed providers, or have the commandcode plugin declare its System One endpoint and the plan's Jev model so `commandcode-plan/typesafe/jev` works directly.

## Version

magpie 0.1.1309, macOS arm64

issue.title: [Bug] redact：普通 key/版本号误判为 SECRET，示例密码导致 paperclip 在后续请求持续被替换

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题

开启内置 secrets 脱敏后，普通仓库/条目标识和软件版本号会被识别为 `SECRET`。被识别过的值随后还会通过 `known` 在其他独立请求中继续被替换。

`paperclip` 的情况需要区分两步：公开连接串示例里的密码位置被识别为 `PASSWORD` 符合当前规则；但识别以后，普通句子 `Open the paperclip repository.` 中的项目名也会持续被替换。干净进程中的这句话本来不会触发。

这会使发给模型的非秘密项目上下文和版本信息被占位符代替。下面全部使用合成值或公开示例，不含真实凭据及用户聊天内容。

## 环境与版本边界

- 实测源码：[main 的固定快照 da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/tree/da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a)，提交时间 `2026-10-23T07:45:27Z`。它是开始复现时读到的最新 main，不声称发布本 issue 时的 main HEAD 仍是这个 commit。
- macOS / darwin arm64；Go `1.26.9`。
- 直接调用实际 `internal/redact` 包的 `MaskJSON`，生产源码未修改。
- 配置为 `redact.Options{Secrets: true}`，仅额外设置 `Seen` 收集命中来源；未启用 Personal、本地 PII 模型、自定义词、规则或 allowlist。
- 上游测试的 `TestMain` 隔离用户配置；每个 case 单独启动一个 `go test` 进程，避免不同用例共享 known 状态。

**这里复现的是包函数行为，未运行 GUI、HTTP 网关、模型厂商请求或两个真实客户端会话的端到端链路。**

## 最小复现与实际结果

输入均作为 `messages[0].content` 交给 `MaskJSON`，不是把内层的 `key` 当成顶层协议字段。以下仅把占位符哈希规范化为 `HASH`，类型和 `rule`/`known` 来源来自真实命中。

### 1. 普通记录和版本号被 rule 识别为 SECRET

每一行从全新的测试进程运行：

| 输入 | 实际输出 |
|---|---|
| `{"key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}` | `{"key":"{{SECRET_HASH}}"}` |
| `{"key":"example1234/demo-repository"}` | `{"key":"{{SECRET_HASH}}"}` |
| `{"versionToken":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}` | `{"versionToken":"{{SECRET_HASH}}"}` |
| `tokenspeed-triton: 3.9.10.post20261008` | `tokenspeed-triton: {{SECRET_HASH}}` |
| `tokenspeed-runner: cu130-torch-2.14.0-flashinfer-0.6.18` | `tokenspeed-runner: {{SECRET_HASH}}` |

以上每项都是 1 次 `rule / SECRET` 命中。

### 2. 公开示例密码使普通项目名在后续请求中命中 known

同一进程内依次调用三次 `MaskJSON`。每次请求都只包含当前消息，没有携带前一条消息历史；`prompt_cache_key` 使用不同的标记值：

```text
请求 B-before：Open the paperclip repository.
输出：Open the paperclip repository.
命中：0

请求 A-seed：postgres://paperclip:paperclip@localhost:5432/paperclip
输出：postgres://paperclip:{{PASSWORD_HASH}}@localhost:5432/paperclip
命中：1，rule / PASSWORD

请求 B-after：Open the paperclip repository.
输出：Open the {{PASSWORD_HASH}} repository.
命中：1，known / PASSWORD
```

仓库标识和版本号也有相同传播：

- `{"source_pr_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}` 在干净进程中保持原样；先运行上表的 `key` 输入后，再请求同一段 `source_pr_key` 内容，就会命中 `known / SECRET`。
- `{"buildVersion":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}` 在干净进程中保持原样；先运行 `versionToken` 输入后，再请求同一段 `buildVersion` 内容，就会命中 `known / SECRET`。
- `issue_key` 的干净进程对照也不触发。不能把 `source_pr_key`、`issue_key`、`buildVersion` 全部归为直接规则误报。

## 可直接运行的复现测试

在上述固定 commit 的源码树中，将下面完整文件保存为 `internal/redact/discord_repro_test.go`。函数名沿用已实跑的复现文件。

```sh
# 添加复现文件前，原包基线已执行并通过：
go test -count=1 ./internal/redact

# 添加文件后，每项单独启动一个进程。以下三个代表用例应真实 FAIL：
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=repo-key go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=version-token go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=paperclip-propagation go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact

# 正常凭据保护对照应 PASS：
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=api-key-control go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact
```

<details>
<summary>完整复现文件：15 个 case，按 MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE 独立运行</summary>

```go
package redact_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"testing"

	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/redact"
)

// Run each case in a fresh go test process so known values cannot leak between cases.
func TestDiscordRedactionRepro(t *testing.T) {
	name := os.Getenv("MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE")
	if name == "" {
		t.Fatal("set MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE; see the accompanying verification record")
	}
	normalize := regexp.MustCompile(`\{\{([A-Z_]+)_[a-z2-7]{8}\}\}`)
	mask := func(request, input string) (string, int) {
		t.Helper()
		var hits []map[string]string
		o := redact.Options{Secrets: true, Seen: func(h redact.Hit) {
			hits = append(hits, map[string]string{"kind": h.Kind, "by": h.By})
		}}
		body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"model": "synthetic", "prompt_cache_key": request,
			"messages": []map[string]string{{"role": "user", "content": input}},
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out, n := redact.MaskJSON(body, o)
		var decoded struct {
			Messages []struct{ Content string }
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &decoded); err != nil || len(decoded.Messages) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("invalid output: %s (%v)", out, err)
		}
		content := decoded.Messages[0].Content
		row, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"case": name, "request": request, "input": input, "masked": n,
			"output": normalize.ReplaceAllString(content, "{{${1}_HASH}}"), "hits": hits,
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Logf("REPRO %s", row)
		if restored := redact.Restore(string(out), false); restored != string(body) {
			t.Fatalf("round trip changed request: %s", restored)
		}
		return content, n
	}
	unchanged := func(request, input string) {
		t.Helper()
		out, n := mask(request, input)
		if out != input || n != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("non-secret text should remain unchanged; masked=%d", n)
		}
	}
	masked := func(request, input string) {
		t.Helper()
		if _, n := mask(request, input); n == 0 {
			t.Fatal("synthetic credential should be masked")
		}
	}

	cases := map[string]string{
		"repo-key":            `{"key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`,
		"repo-name":           `{"key":"example1234/demo-repository"}`,
		"version-token":       `{"versionToken":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}`,
		"tokenspeed-triton":   `tokenspeed-triton: 3.9.10.post20261008`,
		"tokenspeed-runner":   `tokenspeed-runner: cu130-torch-2.14.0-flashinfer-0.6.18`,
		"fresh-source-pr-key": `{"source_pr_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`,
		"fresh-issue-key":     `{"issue_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`,
		"fresh-build-version": `{"buildVersion":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}`,
	}
	if input, ok := cases[name]; ok {
		unchanged("fresh", input)
		return
	}
	switch name {
	case "repo-propagation":
		input := `{"source_pr_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`
		unchanged("conversation-b-before", input)
		mask("conversation-a-seed", cases["repo-key"])
		unchanged("conversation-b-after", input)
	case "version-propagation":
		input := cases["fresh-build-version"]
		unchanged("conversation-b-before", input)
		mask("conversation-a-seed", cases["version-token"])
		unchanged("conversation-b-after", input)
	case "paperclip-propagation":
		const input = "Open the paperclip repository."
		unchanged("conversation-b-before", input)
		masked("conversation-a-seed", "postgres://paperclip:paperclip@localhost:5432/paperclip")
		unchanged("conversation-b-after", input)
	case "api-key-control":
		masked("control", `{"api_key":"sk-proj-SYNTHETICONLY0123456789abcdef"}`)
	case "generic-key-control":
		masked("control", `{"key":"NotARealCredential1234567890abcdef"}`)
	case "db-password-control":
		masked("control", "postgres://demo:SyntheticOnlyPass123@127.0.0.1/demo")
	case "short-password-control":
		masked("seed", "postgres://demo:pass@127.0.0.1/demo")
		unchanged("after", "The tests pass.")
	default:
		t.Fatal("unknown case: " + name)
	}
}
```

</details>

## 预期行为与已完成验证

希望非秘密的项目标识、版本号和普通项目名保留原文，同时继续保护真实凭据；尤其希望避免一次误识别使后续无关请求持续受影响。不是建议关闭整个 known 机制，也不是建议把 `paperclip` 在所有上下文中一概放行。

已实际执行：

- 加入复现文件前，原有 `internal/redact` 包退出码为 0，记录了 58 个测试 PASS 事件，无 FAIL/SKIP。
- 15 个 case 分别在独立进程中执行：5 项直接规则误报和 3 项 known 传播序列的“非秘密文本应保持不变”断言失败；其余 7 项对照通过。这些 FAIL 是问题复现，不是编译失败。
- 7 项对照为：干净进程的 `source_pr_key`、`issue_key`、`buildVersion`；合成 API key、普通 key 字段中的合成凭据、合成 URL 密码；短示例密码 `pass` 不会扩散到普通句子 `The tests pass.`。
- 每一步都验证了 `Restore` 能还原原始 JSON；这里未观察到 JSON 还原失败。

## 源码线索与相关反馈

固定版本的 [redact.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a/internal/redact/redact.go) 中，裸 `key` 的宽泛值规则及字段名中的 `token` 子串匹配能够触发上述样本；[known.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a/internal/redact/known.go) 会在进程内记住长度至少 8 的值，并在后续请求中按同值及边界匹配。尚未实现修复，希望协助确认规则及 known 的置信度/上下文边界。

相关但不同的反馈：[文件名被识别为 EMAIL](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3029)、[PII 模型误判协议字段为 PERSON](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3144)。本报告不依赖本地 PII 模型，只启用内置 secrets 检测，并在消息正文里复现。

AI 辅助披露：Codex 协助调查、编写复现及整理本报告。上述命令已实际执行；没有生产修复，也没有把未运行的 GUI/网关端到端验证写成已通过。
